camel_example: aliyun devops POST /api/v4/projects/check_runs/create_check_run --region cn-hangzhou --organizationId 5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx --accessToken f0b1e61db5961df5975a93f9129d2513 --repositoryIdentity '2835387_或_codeup/codeup-demo' --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body {"conclusion":"success","output":{"summary":"摘要信息内容","images":[{"imageUrl":"xxx","alt":"test-image-alt","caption":"test"}],"text":"详情信息内容","title":"Mighty_Readme_report"},"completedAt":"2023-03-15T08:00:00Z","detailsUrl":"xxx","name":"my-check-ci","startedAt":"2023-03-15T08:00:00Z","externalId":"42","annotations":[{"endLine":2,"path":"demo/test.txt","endColumn":5,"rawDetails":"详情信息内容","startColumn":3,"startLine":1,"annotationLevel":"notice","message":"回写检查注释的简要描述信息","title":"检查注释的标题"}],"headSha":"40f4ccfe019cdd4a62d4acb0c57130106fc7e1be","status":"completed"}
description_en: Creates a check run record only
description_zh: 添加检查运行记录，仅创建
name: CreateCheckRun

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. You can get the organization ID from the URL in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. Example: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrganizationId}
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is optional if you use an AccessKey or STS temporary authorization for authentication
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The ID or full path of the repository
parameters.name: repository_identity

parameters.help_en:
The name of the check run.

The name must be unique for a given repository, commit ID, and author. The maximum length is 50 characters
parameters.help_zh:
检查运行的名称


在一定环境下（指定代码库、提交ID、写入人），名称具有唯一性；长度限制在50以内
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The commit SHA.

This commit must be at the head of a branch that is the source of a merge request
parameters.help_zh:
提交ID


Commit SHA，但需要确保该commit是某个合并请求的合并源
parameters.name: head_sha

parameters.help_en:
The status of the check run. Valid values:

`queued`: Queued

`in_progress`: In progress

`completed`: Completed
parameters.help_zh:
状态

queued：队列中
in_progress：运行中
completed：已完结
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The conclusion of the check run. Valid values:

`cancelled`: Cancelled

`failure`: Failure

`neutral`: Neutral. This is a success state.

`success`: Success

`skipped`: Skipped. This is a success state.

`timed_out`: Timed out
parameters.help_zh:
结论

cancelled：已取消
failure：失败
neutral：中立状态，算作成功状态
success：成功
skipped：跳过，算作成功状态
timed_out：超时
parameters.name: conclusion

parameters.help_en:
The time the check run started.

The time must be in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Example: 2023-03-15T08:00:00Z
parameters.help_zh:
检查运行的开始时间



ISO 8601 格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ，如 2023-03-15T08:00:00Z
parameters.name: started_at

parameters.help_en:
The time the check run completed.

The time must be in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Example: 2023-03-15T08:00:00Z
parameters.help_zh:
检查运行的完结时间


说明 ISO 8601 格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ，如 2023-03-15T08:00:00Z
parameters.name: completed_at

parameters.help_en:
The ID from an external system.

An external system refers to your own check system. Use this field to store an identifier from that system. The platform stores this value as a string and does not interpret it
parameters.help_zh:
外部系统的ID
外部系统，指用户的检测系统；该字段由用户自行决定写入何种ID，平台仅使用字符串类型进行存储
parameters.name: external_id

parameters.help_en: The URL to a page on an external system with full details about the check run. The platform provides a link to this URL
parameters.help_zh: 三方交互系统的详情地址，由用户自行决定，平台仅提供跳转能力
parameters.name: details_url

fields.help_en: The title of the UI module. This is different from the check run 'name'
fields.name: title

fields.help_en:
A summary of the check run.

Supports Markdown. The maximum length is 65,535 characters (64 KB)
fields.help_zh:
检查运行的摘要信息


支持markdown格式；最大字符长度为64KB，即65535个字符
fields.name: summary

fields.help_en:
The details of the check run.

Supports Markdown. The maximum length is 65,535 characters (64 KB)
fields.help_zh:
详情信息


支持markdown格式；最大字符长度为64KB，即65535个字符
fields.name: text

element_fields.help_en: The alternative text for the image
element_fields.name: alt

element_fields.help_en: The URL of the image. The URL must be publicly accessible for the image to be displayed
element_fields.help_zh: 图片地址，须确保能够有效访问，否则页面无法展示
element_fields.name: image_url

element_fields.help_en: A short description of the image
element_fields.name: caption

fields.help_en:
An array of image objects.

Images in this array are displayed in the output module of the check run
fields.help_zh:
图片信息


check run支持在output的展示模块中，展示图片信息
fields.name: images

parameters.help_en: The display information for the check run
parameters.name: output

element_fields.help_en: The path of the file to which the annotation applies
element_fields.name: path

element_fields.help_en:
The starting line of the annotation.

The line number starts from 1. The annotation is not displayed if the line number is invalid for the specified file
element_fields.help_zh:
起始行


从1开始；需要用户自行确保文件行数的有效性，否则无法展示
element_fields.name: start_line

element_fields.help_en: The ending line of the annotation
element_fields.name: end_line

element_fields.help_en:
The starting column of the annotation.

This field is valid only when `startLine` is the same as `endLine`
element_fields.help_zh:
起始列


当且仅当startLine=endLine时，该字段值有效
element_fields.name: start_column

element_fields.help_en:
The ending column of the annotation.

This field is valid only when `startLine` is the same as `endLine`
element_fields.help_zh:
结束列


当且仅当startLine=endLine时，该字段值有效
element_fields.name: end_column

element_fields.help_en:
The severity level of the annotation. Valid values:

`notice`: Notice

`warning`: Warning

`failure`: Failure
element_fields.help_zh:
检查注释的等级

notice：轻微
warning：警告
failure：严重
element_fields.name: annotation_level

element_fields.example: 回写检查注释的简要描述信息
element_fields.help_en: A short, descriptive message for the annotation
element_fields.name: message

element_fields.help_en: Detailed information for the annotation. The maximum size is 64 KB
element_fields.help_zh: 详情信息，限制64KB以内的大小
element_fields.name: raw_details

parameters.help_en:
A list of annotations.

If your external system produces code quality check results, you can provide them here. The results are displayed as annotations on the relevant code
parameters.help_zh:
检查注释列表


对于某些三方系统，可能会获得代码质量检测结果，若希望进行展示，可通过API将信息通过annotation写入到check run中
parameters.name: annotations
